title: Vendor Security Questionnaire (fictional, for the AgentForge demo)
note: Written for AgentForge; not copied from any proprietary questionnaire. demo=true marks the 12-question live-demo subset.

questions.question: Who owns your information security program, and who do they report to?
How often are your security policies reviewed, and who approves them?
Do you perform a formal information security risk assessment? How often?
Do you have a SOC 2 report? Which type, and which trust services criteria does it cover?
Are you certified to ISO/IEC 27001?
Where is the platform hosted, and in which regions?
Can customer data be stored in the European Union?
Is multi-factor authentication required for all workforce accounts?
What type of multi-factor authentication do production administrators use?
Do you run a public bug bounty program, and what is the maximum payout?
How is privileged production access granted, and how long does it last?
How often do you review user access to production systems and customer data?
How quickly is access removed when an employee or contractor leaves?
Is customer data encrypted at rest? Which algorithm do you use?
Which TLS versions do you support for data in transit?
How are encryption keys generated and stored?
How often are the keys that protect customer data rotated?
Will you sign a HIPAA Business Associate Agreement (BAA)?
How many full-time employees work on your security team?
How long do you retain access logs for production systems?
How are logs protected against tampering?
Are security alerts monitored around the clock?
How quickly are security incidents triaged?
How quickly will you notify us of a breach involving our personal data?
Do you test your incident response plan? How often?
What are your recovery point objective (RPO) and recovery time objective (RTO)?
How long are database backups retained, and where are they stored?
How often do you test backup restores and disaster recovery failover?
How do you review the security of your critical vendors?
Will you notify us before adding a new subprocessor? How much notice do you give?
Is code reviewed before it reaches production?
What are your remediation timelines for critical and high vulnerabilities?
Do you perform independent penetration tests? How often?
What happens to our data after our contract ends?
Do you sign a data processing agreement, and how are transfers out of the EEA covered?
Do you perform background checks on new employees?
How often do employees complete security awareness training?
Do you hold a FedRAMP authorization? At which impact level?
Are you PCI DSS compliant, and at which merchant or service provider level?
What is the coverage limit of your cyber liability insurance policy?
